features.name: log_p3_scaled
features.description: Log-transformed P3 to compress its heavy-tailed distribution into a near-linear scale suitable for SVM margins.
features.expected_model_benefit: Linearizes a highly skewed magnitude variable so a linear separator can exploit it.

features.name: p3_zscore_clipped
features.description: Standardized P3 using training mean/std, clipped to [-5,5] to limit outlier influence on linear margin.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a bounded continuous projection of P3 stable for linear weights.

features.name: p11p3_centered
features.description: P11p3 centered by training mean to provide zero-mean continuous signal.
features.expected_model_benefit: Zero-mean smooth feature aids linear SVM intercept calibration.

features.name: p16p2_centered
features.description: P16p2 centered by its training mean.
features.expected_model_benefit: Smooth centered proportion variable useful for linear projection.

features.name: h15p1_centered
features.description: H15p1 centered by training mean to expose deviation from typical magnitude.
features.expected_model_benefit: Centered continuous variable improves linear margin geometry.

features.name: p6p4_log_severity
features.description: Log-compressed P6p4 to expose small-value variation as a smooth severity score.
features.expected_model_benefit: Compresses skew so linear weight captures gradual changes.

features.name: p19p2_log_severity
features.description: Log-compressed P19p2 to smooth its right-skewed distribution.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a smoother continuous proxy for P19p2 useful for linear projection.

features.name: h5p2_to_h40p4_ratio
features.description: Ratio of H5p2 over H40p4 (with small denominator floor) capturing relative housing proportion structure.
features.expected_model_benefit: Ratio summarizes joint behavior of two proportions into a single linear-friendly feature.

features.name: p16p2_minus_p11p3
features.description: Difference between two proportion-like columns, capturing relative gap.
features.expected_model_benefit: Linear differences across normalized proportions reveal contrasts a linear SVM can weigh.

features.name: weighted_proportion_composite
features.description: Weighted composite of bounded proportion features acting as a smooth severity index.
features.expected_model_benefit: Compact linear projection over correlated bounded features improves margin signal.

features.name: p3_h15p1_interaction
features.description: Product of log P3 and centered H15p1 to expose joint magnitude–household interaction.
features.expected_model_benefit: Captures interaction in a form a linear SVM can use as an explicit dimension.

features.name: household_stability_judgment
features.description: Semantic judgment score of household stability combining H15p1 magnitude and H40p4 proportion: higher when H15p1 is near typical range and H40p4 is moderate-to-high, lower for extreme deviations.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a smooth bounded semantic indicator of stable household profile not captured by single columns.
